p5_b1.ocr: There was no colour change noticed in any of the lin- ings over the trial period except for dust coverage that made white (untreated) linings appear brown. All the participants were pleased with the colour of the lining that was installed in their homes. Reasons for the positive response towards lining colour varied (Table 5) but not all participants supplied reasons. Eight of the 40 partici- pants indicated that the linings were decorative. “The net is too much good. It decorate my room and it kill mosquitoes and cockroaches” (female, age 48, house with orange lining).
